account.captureFileNameDefault: Date and time - Service name - Program name
account.captureFileNameHelp: Write it the same way as recording file names: {{items}}. The TVTest-style macros ({{macros}}) also work. If empty, "Date and time - Service name - Program name" is used. Example: {{example}}
account.lowLatencyHelp: In live viewing, when the delay from the broadcast exceeds 3 seconds, playback speeds up to 1.1x to catch up. On slow connections, playback may stall more often.
account.cmAutoSkipHelp: When playback of a recording enters a section detected as commercials, jump to its end. Detection can be wrong. Sections you pick yourself, such as with the seek bar, are not skipped.
account.fieldRateHelp: Shows interlaced broadcasts at 59.94p, one picture per field, for smoother motion. Applies when the browser converts the stream itself. On devices that cannot keep up, playback falls back to one picture per frame (29.97p).
account.interpolationHelp: Inserts frames estimated from motion between the frames of 30 or 24 fps video, timed to your display's refresh. When the browser converts the stream, applies to 24p film rebuilt from pulldown and to 29.97p when 1080i is not shown field by field. The picture is delayed by one frame (about 0.03 to 0.04 seconds); if speech looks out of sync, delay the audio with the audio sync setting. Fast motion and scene changes may show artifacts.
account.interpolationRateHelp: Choose this on fast displays to reduce the GPU load. Browsers do not tell the refresh rate, so by default it is measured from the refresh interval.
account.dataBroadcastZipcodeHelp: Passed to data broadcasting that selects a region by postal code, such as weather and news. Enter 7 digits. Leave empty to not pass it.
account.dataBroadcastZipcodeInvalid: Enter the postal code as 7 digits
account.watchPositionsHelp: Deletes all of your watch positions. Continue Watching becomes empty and every recording starts from the beginning. This cannot be undone.
account.watchPositionsClearFailed: Could not delete the watch positions
account.deleteAccountHelp: Deletes your account and personal data such as watch positions, captures, notifications, and linked accounts, along with recordings saved on this device. Recordings, reservations, and rules are shared with the household and are kept. Audit logs are kept until their retention period ends. This cannot be undone. The last administrator cannot be deleted.
account.dataBroadcastStorageHelp: Deletes data that data broadcasting programs have saved on this device. Try this if the display stays broken. The postal code is kept.
account.dataBroadcastPreloadHelp: Speeds up data broadcasting display during live viewing. Requires an additional TS stream, which uses about 2 Mbps of bandwidth.
account.autoPictureInPicture: Automatically show in a separate window when switching tabs
account.autoPictureInPictureHelp: When you move to another tab during playback, the player is shown in a small window.
account.fullscreenLandscapeHelp: When you enter fullscreen, the device is locked to landscape. It is unlocked when you leave fullscreen. Devices and browsers that do not support it are not locked.
account.swipeControls: Swipe the edges to change brightness and volume
account.swipeControlsHelp: In fullscreen, swipe up or down on the left edge of the video to change the brightness, and on the right edge to change the volume. On devices where the volume cannot be changed (such as iPad), only the brightness changes.

account.passkeyUnavailable: Passkeys cannot be used on this page. Open it over HTTPS or localhost.
account.apiTokensDescription: Tokens for using the EPGStation-compatible read-only API from external apps. A token can read the guide and recordings with the permissions of the user who issued it.
account.apiTokensDisabled: An administrator has turned off the EPGStation-compatible API. The tokens you issued cannot be used now. You can still revoke them.
account.calendarFeedDescription: Subscribe to recording reservations in calendar apps (Google Calendar, iPhone Calendar, and so on) with iCalendar. Anyone who knows the URL can read the reservations as you, so do not share it. Reissuing makes the previous URL stop working.
account.calendarFeedIssued: This is the subscription URL. It is not shown again after you leave this page. Add it as a subscription by URL in your calendar app.
account.noCalendarFeed: No subscription URL has been issued
account.iptvFeedDescription: Serves the live channel list (M3U) and the program guide (XMLTV) to IPTV clients such as Kodi, Jellyfin, and Plex. Streams are unconverted TS. Anyone who knows the URL can watch live TV and read the guide as you, so do not share it. This URL is separate from the reservation calendar. Reissuing makes the previous URL stop working.
account.iptvFeedIssued: These are the URLs for your IPTV client. They are not shown again after you leave this page.

account.iptvFeedDisabled: An administrator has turned off IPTV client URLs. The URL you issued cannot be used now. You can still revoke it.
account.apiTokenIssued: The API token has been issued. It is shown only now. Save it somewhere safe.

settings.recordingDefaultsNote: Used for items not overridden by a rule or reservation
settings.ruleDefaultsNote: Values prefilled when creating a new rule. Existing rules do not change.
settings.ruleUnmatchedGrace: Keep reservations that stop matching (minutes before airtime)
settings.ruleUnmatchedGraceHelp: When a program guide update makes a reservation stop matching its rule, it is still recorded if the program starts within this time. 0 keeps none. When the rule is deleted or disabled, its reservations are deleted even within this time.
settings.poolHelp: When automatic, the pool that fits the estimated size is chosen in order of priority.
settings.fileNameTemplateHelp: Written in Go's text/template. The available syntax is listed in the table under "Show available syntax" below.
settings.priorityHelp: -10 to 10. When there are not enough tuners, higher-priority reservations get tuners first.
settings.joinSegments: Join split recording files into one
settings.joinSegmentsHelp: When a recording's files are split by an update or restart, they are joined into one file after the recording ends. If the overlaps do not match, the files are left split.
settings.tvtplayChapters: Write TvtPlay chapter files after detecting commercial breaks
settings.tvtplayChaptersHelp: Puts a chapter file (.chapter) that skips commercials in the chapters folder next to the recording file. TvtPlay for TVTest skips commercials when it opens the recording. Existing files with the same name are not overwritten.
settings.cmDetectorHelp: The station logo method is experimental. It treats the parts where the station logo in the corner is missing as commercials. Recordings whose logo cannot be learned (such as shopping slots without a station logo) are detected by silence and scene changes. If a station hides its logo during an opening, that part is also treated as a commercial. Changing this keeps the previous result until a recording is detected again.
settings.detectCmHelp: Reads the recording with FFmpeg and marks the sections considered commercials on the seek bar. Recordings whose reservation or rule chooses Detect or Don't detect follow that setting. Turning this off keeps sections already detected.
settings.transcodeHelp: After recording, transcode the recording to MP4 and add it as an other file (the original TS is kept). Rules and reservations can choose this too. nekonote transcodes with FFmpeg, using the same encoder setting as kyusu.
settings.transcodeFrameRateHelp: How many frames per second an interlaced broadcast is transcoded to. Auto measures several places in the recording before transcoding, and uses 30 fps for anime, film (24p), and 30p, and 60 fps for live action (60i). Progressive video such as 720p or BS4K keeps its frame rate. Rules and reservations can choose this too.
settings.archiveRetentionHelp: Number of days to keep programs that have finished airing in the guide and search. 0 keeps them indefinitely.
settings.watchProgressRetentionHelp: Number of days to keep watch positions. Positions not updated for longer than this are deleted daily and leave Continue Watching. 0 keeps them indefinitely.
settings.notificationRetentionHelp: Number of days to keep in-app notifications. Notifications older than this are deleted daily, whether read or unread. 0 keeps them indefinitely.
settings.mcpHelp: Lets MCP clients such as Claude and ChatGPT work with programs, reservations, rules, and recordings. When disabled, neither new integrations nor already connected apps can be used.
settings.dataBroadcastIpHelp: Kotatsu's server relays the requests that data broadcast documents send to the internet, such as polls and prize entries. They may include receiver information such as the postal code. Requests to addresses inside your LAN are refused.
settings.externalPlayerUrlsEnabled: Issue URLs to open in VLC or mpv
settings.externalPlayerUrlsHelp: Lets users issue URLs to open recordings and live channels in an external player. Anyone who has a URL can open it until it expires. Turning this off also stops URLs that were already issued, before they expire.
settings.recordingDownloadsEnabled: Let users download recordings as files
settings.recordingDownloadsHelp: Lets users save a recording as a single TS file from the recording page. The saved file can be played outside Kotatsu or moved elsewhere. Saving to the device for offline viewing works regardless of this setting.
settings.epgstationApiHelp: Lets EPGStation-compatible clients such as kiririn read the guide, recordings, and live and recorded video. Users can then issue API tokens from the security settings. Anyone who has a token can use it until it is revoked. Turning this off also stops tokens that were already issued.
settings.iptvFeedsEnabled: Issue URLs to watch in Kodi or Jellyfin
settings.iptvFeedsHelp: Lets users issue, from the security settings, URLs that serve the live channel list and guide to IPTV clients. Anyone who has a URL can use it until it is revoked. Turning this off also stops URLs that were already issued.

NX_JIKKYO.title: Niconico Jikkyo
NX_JIKKYO.label: Use Niconico Jikkyo
NX_JIKKYO.help: Lets viewers overlay live comments on live TV and recordings. Kotatsu's server connects to NX-Jikkyo and the past comment API. Each viewer also has to turn it on in their player settings.

NICOLOG.title: NICOLOG
NICOLOG.label: Use NICOLOG comments
NICOLOG.help: Lets recordings show comments from Niconico Live screenings. The Kotatsu server connects to NICOLOG. Available for recordings with commercial sections. Users also need to enable it in their player settings.

settings.animeEnabled: Link with Syobocal, Annict, and AniList
settings.animeHelp: Matches anime and tokusatsu programs to works and episodes on Syobocal, and shows the episode number, subtitle, and links to Annict and AniList on program and recording details. When enabled, Kotatsu sends requests to Syobocal and GitHub
settings.animeNotImported: No linking data has been imported yet. Once enabled, it is imported and refreshed every day
settings.animeTokenHelp: Used to build the work ID mapping from Annict and AniList. It takes precedence over the arm mapping and also covers new works missing from arm. Create a personal access token with read scope in the Applications settings on Annict and enter it here
settings.networkActivityRetentionHelp: Number of days to keep the record. Older records are deleted daily.
